pick.headline: Troops clear Tiananmen Square
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 7, 1989, carried Bratislava PRAVDA via CTK: Chinese television confirmed tanks, tear gas and firearms were used to clear Tiananmen Square, with victims put at dozens to hundreds.

alternates.headline: Jerry Rawlings seizes power in Ghana
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of June 6, 1979, carried Moscow TASS in English: Accra Radio announced junior officers had overthrown General Akuffo's government, imposed a curfew, and kept the June 18 election date.

alternates.headline: Solidarity sweeps Poland's partially free elections
alternates.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 7, 1989, carried Prague Domestic Service citing Polish dailies: Solidarity candidates won 'considerable success', many seats faced a second round, and almost 40 percent stayed home.
